display.purpose: Hero and major editorial section headlines.

body.purpose: Standard narrative copy and UI text.

narrative.overview: BlessMe's visual system evokes a serene, tactile, and high-end culinary publication. The identity marries classical typography with contemporary minimalist spacing, conveying trust, culinary precision, and premium wholesale quality.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper & roasted ink contrast (no pure black text).
Refined editorial serif headlines with clean, modern sans-serif body copy.
Tactile pill buttons, soft border separations, and gentle spring micro-interactions.
Seamless dual-language typography harmony between English and Thai (DB Ozone X Med).

rules.name: The Organic Harmony Rule
rules.body: Black text is forbidden; all high-contrast typography uses roasted earth ink (#2B241E) to harmonize with paper canvases (#FAF6EF).

rules.name: The Dual-Language Optical Match Rule
rules.body: Thai text in DB Ozone X must render at ~110-120% font size compared to English Inter/Fraunces equivalents to maintain optical weight balance across language switches.

dos: Do maintain the cream paper canvas (#FAF6EF) across all marketing pages.
Do ensure every interactive element provides clear hover and focus feedback.
Do test Thai translation switching to verify typography size overrides.
Do keep unit economics and wholesale margins prominent for B2B clarity.
donts: Don't use pure #000000 black or generic saturated blue hyperlinks.
Don't use harsh box shadows or neon border glows.
Don't introduce generic placeholder iconography or cluttered bento boxes.
